name: date-time-picker
title: Date Time Picker
description: A date from the calendar and a time of day as one local "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" value, composed from UI SDK DatePicker and TimeInput, with min/max, a time zone suffix and locale formatting.
docs: `<DateTimePicker value onValueChange min max locale timeZone labels>` inside a `Field`: the field's label names the date and `labels.time` ("Time" by default) names the time, which sits in its own inner Field so the two never share an id or a name. Keep the time's label free of the date label's words (agents match labels by their words, so "Departure" and "Departure time" collide). The value is a local `"2026-11-02T14:30"`; `onValueChange` runs once both parts are set, and with `null` when either is cleared. `min`/`max` take the same shape: the date picker stops at their dates, and the time input at their times on those days. `timeZone` shows the zone's short name after the time, describes the time input and sets the calendar's today; the value stays local. `locale` sets the date format and the clock (`hourCycle` overrides it). `name` submits the combined value. Inside a `FormField` it binds like any other control. `TimeInput` is exported, styled, for a time on its own.
